name: Geyser
description:
TIDES SMP - Water-World Survival (Bedrock + Java crossplay)

Tides is a survival SMP where the map is mostly ocean and land is scarce. Every island matters. Find a spot, build on the water, and survive the depths with a community that explores together.

FRIDAY NIGHT MASS JOIN - every Friday at 9 PM ET

The whole server logs on at the same time every week, so you never join an empty world. Show up Friday and meet everyone at once.

WHY PLAYERS JOIN

- Bedrock + Java crossplay: mobile, console, and PC on one world

- No pay-to-win

- Invite rewards: every friend you bring earns you an Invite Diamond. 5 invites = Iron Block, 10 = Diamond Chestplate, 50 = 2x Netherite Ingot. New players get a welcome gift too.

- Discord-linked accounts (/link) so rewards land automatically

- Custom plugins built in-house and updated every week (maintenance on Thursdays so Fridays run smooth)

- Part of the NightClub Network

HOW TO JOIN

Bedrock: listed-completing.gl.at.ply.gg Port: 35634

(Bedrock usernames start with a period, e.g. .YourName. That's normal!)

Java: pm-twirl.gl.joinmc.link

Discord: discord.gg/5H95BxNQh3

See you Friday at 9 PM ET.
